messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=runtime-api env=prod-eu2 tag=release-2027.03.12 sha=af3c9b2 triggered_by=chris. Canary=10% (eu2-north). Change window=open. Logs: https://logs.internal/release/af3c9b2

chris: FYI landing now, monitoring.

sylvia: watching canary, will report any errors.

kenji: seeing a small spike in 5xx from canary at ~18:02 UTC, looks related to kv-cache misses. cc @oncall-julie can you check? :eyes:

sylvia: stack snippet from canary pods:
```
ERROR runtime.kv: failed to fetch prefix, err=invalid-kv-length
  at runtime/cache.go:213
  at runtime/handler.go:88
```

oncall-julie: I'm on it, pulling traces now. These traces show elevated latency on tail requests.

kenji: this is impacting request success for certain prompt patterns. I recommend rolling back to previous stable tag. Preparing to pin old release if rollback succeeds.

maria: agree, don't want the error to hit more regions. Ready to validate traces post-rollback.

kenji: @deploy-bot please start fallback to tag=release-2027.02.28 env=prod-eu2. Reason=canary 5xx spike, kv-cache regression.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: target=release-2027.02.28 env=prod-eu2 initiated_by=kenji. Steps queued: [scale-down release-2027.03.12, deploy release-2027.02.28, run healthchecks, pin-version]. ETA ~3m. Trace: https://deploys.internal/ops/1823456789

maria: mirroring canary traffic to old tag to validate behavior.

deploy-bot: Progress update: step1 complete (scaled down new pods). step2 in progress (deploying old tag).

sylvia: confirming, I can already see error rate dropping on the mirrored traffic.

deploy-bot: Progress update: step2 complete. Running healthchecks.

deploy-bot: Healthcheck results: 35/35 pods ready, 99.9th p50 latency within baseline.

maria: looks clean on traces, error rate returned to baseline.

kenji: pinning config to previous tag to avoid automatic re-deploy: `service.runtime.version=release-2027.02.28` (pushed to infra-config repo).

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: env=prod-eu2 completed_by=deploy-bot completed_at=1823456825 status=success. Pin applied. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/rollback/1823456789

chris: thanks team. Opening a follow-up: RID-874 (postmortem + regression test). Blocking next change window for runtime-api until we have root cause and safe canary plan.

sylvia: I'll assemble the failing input corpus and repro steps, tagging @eng-ml for kv-cache regression analysis.

oncall-julie: thanks, will hand off any paging notes to oncall rotation.

maria: recommend we also add an automated smoke test for that prompt pattern in canary checks.

kenji: agreed, will add to rollout checklist. Good job everyone :tada:
